description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Context Settings: You can now enter a domain like example.com in the icon picker to use that context icon
🐞 Fixes
- Tags: When the connected contexts share more than one tag, the sidebar now show all of them (#prod #aws) instead of only the first tag #585
- Resource Lists: Ages of 100 days or more no longer show the hour.
- CRDs: Fixed a crash when opening some custom resources like DatadogMetric
